entry.import.google-drive.title: Import from Google Drive
entry.import.google-drive.step1: Download the files you want from Google Drive.
entry.import.google-drive.step2: For Google Docs, Sheets or Slides, use File → Download to choose a format.
entry.import.google-drive.step3: Unzip any archive and put the downloaded files in a folder, then choose that folder here.
entry.import.google-drive.outcome: Copies downloaded files into a new local project. No Google account connection or ongoing sync.

entry.import.notion.title: Import from Notion
entry.import.notion.step1: In Notion, open the page or workspace menu and choose Export.
entry.import.notion.step2: Pick Markdown & CSV and include subpages.
entry.import.notion.step3: Unzip the download, then choose that folder here.
entry.import.notion.outcome: Copies exported Markdown and CSV files into a new local project on this computer.
entry.import.app.title: Add folders from {provider}
entry.import.app.outcome: Folders stay where they are. PuppyOne lists them on your Homepage.
entry.import.app.empty: {provider} has no folders on this computer.
entry.import.airtable.title: Import from Airtable
entry.import.airtable.step1: In Airtable, open a view and choose Download CSV.
entry.import.airtable.step2: Repeat for each table and put the files in one folder.
entry.import.airtable.outcome: Copies the exported CSV files into a new local project you can edit.
